title: DraftSaveRequest
description: POST /api/pipelines/:id/draft/save body (HEL-1629, docs/live-draft-preview.md section 8). `steps` and `outputs` are the FINAL tree, diffed against the stored definition: an item carrying an `id` is an existing step or Output of THIS pipeline (any other id is a 400: explicit ids are accepted only when the server restores a journaled definition on undo); an item carrying a `clientId` is new. A step names exactly one of `parentStepId` (an existing step of the draft), `parentClientId` (a new step of the draft), `rootId` or `rootClientId` (a parentless step names its root, a stored one or a new one of `roots`); an Output names exactly one of `nodeStepId`, `nodeStepClientId`, `rootId` or `rootClientId`. A stored step the draft omits is DELETED, with its tail subtree only if the draft omits it too: the server never deletes a step the draft keeps. `baseFingerprint` is the `fingerprint` of the `GET /api/pipelines/:id` the draft was based on; a stale base answers 409 PATCH_SET_STALE and there is no overwrite path of any kind. Removals (steps, Outputs and the panels and alert rules they cascade into) must be listed in `confirmCascade`, else 422 with the impact.

runAfterSave.description: When set, the server submits a run through the unchanged HEL-505 guard AFTER the save has committed. A guard rejection is reported in the response and never rolls the save back.

roots.description: HEL-1734: the FINAL roots (sources) of the draft, in order; each root's position is its index. Absent: the stored roots are left unchanged. A stored root the list omits is removed with its steps, Outputs and node snapshots, in the same transaction (list it in `confirmCascade.rootIds`). An empty list is a 400 (a pipeline keeps at least one root). The surviving roots must keep their stored relative order and new roots must follow every survivor. A step or Output may name a new root by `rootClientId`.

id.description: A root of THIS pipeline that stays. It must not carry `sourceId` (a survivor's source cannot change).

clientId.description: A new root, minted by the client.

sourceId.description: The data source of a new root; it must be owned by the caller, else 404.

config.description: Output config, validated per kind exactly as POST /api/pipelines/:id/outputs (outputs/create-output-request.schema.json documents every key). An insight Output (HEL-1740) accepts only preset, prompt, reads {outputs, windows}, refresh, maxSentences, maxChars, model (a selectable model id, HEL-1743) and an empty fieldMapping; reads.outputs must name other non-insight Outputs this draft keeps (stored ids), never the insight itself.
